items.title: Professional wrestling holds
items.summary: In professional wrestling, a hold is any kind of move used by a performer to stop their opponent from being able to move. The hold may lead to a submission from the opponent. Some examples of holds are the cloverleaf, the keylock, and the guillotine choke.
